messages:
docs-bot: Automated link-scan finished for /runtime/nav and found 7 links pointing to /api/v1/old-endpoint (404 on staging). Please triage.

maria_docs: Thanks — can someone own a quick sweep? seems like a few short redirects and one inline example to update.

alex_dev: I can take the sweep. allocating 30m now, will open a PR for the redirect and inline snippet fixes. anyone aware of downstream localized pages?

josh_infra: heads-up: if you add redirects, please coordinate with the CDN team — we need a 24h propagation note if we add a shortlink redirect. otherwise fine.

omar_loc: there are ja/ and es/ versions that mirror the nav file. I can grep the i18n tree after the PR but prefer patch that doesn't break keys.

lia_prod: also double-check runbook cross-links, the runbook references the old endpoint in an example curl. that one is user-visible so prefer a redirect + bump example.

alex_dev: plan: 1) replace inline path in docs runtime/nav and runbook example, 2) add redirect rule from /api/v1/old-endpoint -> /api/v2/runtime/generate, 3) ping CDN for propagation. quick sed I used locally:

```bash
# replace markdown links in runtime docs, confirm with --dry-run first
grep -R "api/v1/old-endpoint" docs/ | sed -n '1,200p'
# then in repo (example):
# perl -0777 -pe "s|/api/v1/old-endpoint|/api/v2/runtime/generate|g" -i.bak docs/runtime/*.md
```

maria_docs: sounds good. please add a short changelog line and include me as reviewer for the content change.

alex_dev: opening PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 (content edits + redirect rule in infra/redirects.yaml). tagging @maria_docs @josh_infra @omar_loc.

josh_infra: noted, I'll flag CDN team via the deploy bot and schedule a low-risk rollout window.

omar_loc: I'll run a quick search/replace in the ja/es docs after the PR merges. if any i18n keys changed, I'll open follow-up PRs.

lia_prod: small nit — update the runbook example header to note "deprecated endpoint" for a week so SREs don't get confused during rotation.

alex_dev: good call, adding a comment line in the runbook. PR updated.

maria_docs: reviewing now. looks small — will approve if tests pass. :thumbsup:

alex_dev: thanks — merging on green. will post a short post-merge note with redirect window and CDN ticket ID.

docs-bot: Link-scan alert resolved (manual). Task: redirect added, docs updated, localization follow-ups filed.

lia_prod: thanks everyone. quick win!
